title: FG’s ₦50,000 NERSI Relief: Who Qualifies, How Selection Works, and How to Claim Safely
summary: The Federal Government’s National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention (NERSI) is paying ₦50,000 to selected vulnerable households. Beneficiaries are drawn from the National Social Register and NIN records — not open applications. Verified quotes, payment path, and anti-scam steps.
